Committee: Children and Senior Advocacy
Sponsor: Wadsworth
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/19/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 204 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment, which if ratified, would remove probate court jurisdiction over orphans business in each county.
In addition, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
K. L. Brown, Chair
Children and Senior Advocacy
